items.sourceHeadline: Kenya Airways to reveal potential new investors as losses deepen
items.sourceDescription: Kenya Airways says it expects to disclose potential new investors within weeks as it seeks capital to reduce debt pressure, return grounded aircraft to service and fund its turnaround. The carrier reported a corrected first-half pre-tax loss of 15.92 billion Kenyan shillings, up from 12.17 billion shillings a year earlier, while its chairman said interest had come from local and international investors.
items.whyItMatters: The capital raise is now tied to balance-sheet restructuring, fleet availability and the limits of state support. Investor interest is not a completed transaction, and the ownership terms remain unresolved.
items.inferenceOrUnresolved: No investor, valuation, transaction structure or completed capital commitment was announced.

items.sourceHeadline: Son of Uganda's president says he will stand for top job in 2031
items.sourceDescription: Uganda's military chief Muhoozi Kainerugaba, President Yoweri Museveni's son, said he intends to run for president in 2031. Reuters notes that he previously declared an intention to run in the last election before withdrawing and backing his father.
items.whyItMatters: The declaration makes succession politics more explicit but does not establish a candidacy or election outcome. The institutional question is how military command, party power and electoral competition remain separated.
items.inferenceOrUnresolved: The statement is an intention five years ahead; party nomination, ballot access and President Museveni's plans are unresolved.

items.sourceHeadline: Tanzania's vice president resigns in less than a year
items.sourceDescription: Tanzania's government said Vice President Emmanuel John Nchimbi will leave office on September 4 after President Samia Suluhu Hassan accepted his resignation. The official statement gave no reason and said constitutional procedures would be used to appoint a successor.
items.whyItMatters: The vacancy creates an immediate constitutional transition inside the governing system. Any causal connection to Nchimbi's recent constitutional-reform remarks would be inference, not an established fact.
items.inferenceOrUnresolved: The government did not state a reason for the resignation or name a successor.

items.sourceHeadline: Health Emergency Preparedness, Response and Resilience Project for Eastern and Southern Africa (P180127)
items.sourceDescription: IGAD published the regional context and implementation controls for its health-emergency preparedness and resilience project, including environmental and social commitments, staffing, monitoring, reporting and grievance-management requirements. The page states that the International Development Association is providing original and additional financing under project agreements.
items.whyItMatters: Cross-border disease preparedness depends on the implementation layer, not only the financing announcement. The disclosed controls identify where readiness and accountability can be tested as the project moves forward.
items.inferenceOrUnresolved: The page does not state a new financing amount, approval date or completion result; none is inferred.
